scope.note: Extension-only. Both diseases were built as mirrored/identical structures by the Liver Production Knowledge Manifest v1 (PR #41, merged) -- this manifest applies every addition identically to both, matching the Pulmonary Clinical Evidence Blueprint's symmetric extension pattern (not the asymmetric Renal pattern).

already_present_verified.note: Every requested liver finding/complication/hospice-eligibility-support item except MELD Score, Elevated Serum Bilirubin, Hyponatremia, and Recurrent Liver Disease Hospitalization was verified already present in PR #41 (identically, for both diseases) under an identical name. No duplicate concept was created for any of these.

mapping.existing_concept: Abnormal Liver Function Tests (FINDING, already present)
PPS Less Than 70 Percent (HOSPICE_ELIGIBILITY_SUPPORT, already present)
KPS Less Than 70 Percent (HOSPICE_ELIGIBILITY_SUPPORT, already present)

new_concepts.name: MELD Score
new_concepts.description: Model For End-Stage Liver Disease composite score reflecting severity of hepatic dysfunction. A rising or elevated MELD score supports documentation of progressive liver disease severity; it does not by itself establish terminal prognosis or hospice eligibility.

new_concepts.name: Elevated Serum Bilirubin
new_concepts.description: Elevated total serum bilirubin reflecting worsening hepatic synthetic/excretory function, distinct from the existing Elevated INR, Low Serum Albumin, and Abnormal Liver Function Tests findings. Requires documented patient-record laboratory evidence before being treated as a patient-specific fact.

new_concepts.name: Hyponatremia
new_concepts.description: Low serum sodium associated with advanced/decompensated liver disease and worsening prognosis when present alongside other hepatic decompensation findings. Requires documented patient-record laboratory evidence before being treated as a patient-specific fact.

new_concepts.name: Recurrent Liver Disease Hospitalization
new_concepts.description: Recurrent hospitalization for complications of liver disease supports documentation of disease severity and recertification review. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

functional_assessment_linkage.description: Links each Liver disease's existing PPS Less Than 70 Percent hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's PPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

Links each Liver disease's existing KPS Less Than 70 Percent hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's KPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

trend_indicators.name: PPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Palliative Performance Scale score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: KPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Karnofsky Performance Status score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: INR Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current INR value, tracked across recertification periods to document worsening hepatic synthetic function.

trend_indicators.name: Albumin Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current serum albumin value, tracked across recertification periods to document worsening hepatic synthetic function and nutritional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Bilirubin Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current total serum bilirubin value, tracked across recertification periods to document worsening hepatic excretory function.

trend_indicators.name: Ascites Episode Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency/severity of ascites episodes (including refractory or recurrent large-volume paracentesis) across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Encephalopathy Episode Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency/severity of hepatic encephalopathy episodes across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Weight Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current weight, tracked across recertification periods to document nutritional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Hospitalization Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency of hospitalization for liver disease complications, tracked across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Narrative Trend
trend_indicators.description: Free-text nurse narrative summarizing overall clinical decline across recertification periods, supporting but never replacing physician-supported prognosis determination.
